# mdk API reference (v0.3.0)

Generated from framework/guide.json (same data as `./mdk guide`).

## App contract

1. An app is a directory of .src files. mdk prepends framework/*.src and compiles them together with machin (encode concatenates files: that is the module system).
2. Define exactly one `func view()`. It runs every frame that needs drawing (input, resize, reload, or animate()).
3. Do not define main(). The framework exports mdk_frame, which wraps view() in arena { } so a frame's temporaries are freed when it returns.
4. Keep state in the host store: state_int/set_int, state_f/set_f, state_str/set_str. It survives every hot reload; MFL globals do not (they reset on reload).
5. Never assign per-frame values to MFL globals: inside the frame arena, a global assignment promotes the value out of it and leaks every frame. Assigning a global once (a cache filled on first frame) is fine.
6. Build the UI top-down every frame: open containers with col()/row(), add content, close with end(). Modifiers (gap, bg, pad, ...) apply to the LAST created element, or to the container just closed by end().
7. Widgets return their event for this frame: if button("Save") { ... }.
8. Window title and default size: an optional app.conf in the app dir (title=Notes, size=1180x760); window_title(s) changes the title at run time.

## Functions

### containers

- `col() -> int` — open a vertical container (children top to bottom); returns its element index
- `row() -> int` — open a horizontal container (children left to right)
- `end()` — close the innermost open container; following modifiers target it
- `spacer() -> int` — an empty element with grow 1: pushes siblings apart
- `vlist(n int, row_h float, scroll float) -> (first int, count int)` — open a virtualized list of n fixed-height rows scrolled to `scroll` px; build exactly rows first..first+count-1 (each height(row_h)), then end()
- `scroll_view(key string) -> int` — open a vertical container that clips its children and scrolls with the wheel while hovered; offset kept in the state store under key; close with end()
- `card() -> int` — open a surface card (bg, radius 12, border, padding 18, gap 8); close with end()

### content

- `text(s string, size float) -> int` — one line of text at size px (shaped with HarfBuzz, cached)
- `para(s string, size float) -> int` — a paragraph: wraps at spaces to the width its container gives it
- `label(s string) -> int` — text at the current element's font size
- `md_view(src string) -> int` — render block markdown: # ## ### headings, - * bullets, - [ ] / - [x] tasks, > quotes, ``` code fences, --- rules, paragraphs (inline marks shown as typed)

### widgets

- `button(s string) -> bool` — accent button; true on the frame it is clicked (press and release inside)
- `button_ghost(s string) -> bool` — outlined surface button; same semantics
- `button_styled(s string, base int, hover int, pressed int) -> bool` — button with your own three colors
- `text_field(key string, placeholder string) -> string` — single-line input; value and caret kept in the state store under key; click to focus, type (UTF-8/IME), Backspace/Delete/ctrl+Backspace, Left/Right/Home/End, ctrl+v paste
- `text_area(key string, placeholder string) -> string` — multi-line editor filling its container: Return/Tab/Up/Down too; scrolls with the wheel and follows the caret; long lines are clipped (no soft wrap yet)
- `nav_item(label string, active bool) -> bool` — sidebar entry, highlighted when active; true when clicked
- `list_item(title string, sub string, active bool) -> bool` — two-line list entry; true when clicked
- `avatar(name string, diameter float) -> int` — round avatar with initials, colored from the name
- `badge(s string, rgba int) -> int` — small pill label
- `divider() -> int` — 1 px horizontal rule

### layout

- `fill()` — take all space on both axes (grow on the main axis, stretch on the cross axis)
- `fillw()` — take all horizontal space
- `fillh()` — take all vertical space
- `width(px float)` — fixed width
- `height(px float)` — fixed height
- `size(w float, h float)` — fixed width and height
- `pad(px float)` — padding on all sides
- `padxy(x float, y float)` — horizontal and vertical padding
- `gap(px float)` — space between children
- `grow(f float)` — share of the free main-axis space
- `align(A_START|A_CENTER|A_STRETCH|A_END)` — children's cross-axis alignment
- `justify(J_START|J_CENTER|J_END|J_BETWEEN)` — children's main-axis distribution (when nothing grows)
- `center()` — align + justify center
- `scroll_y(px float)` — offset a vertical container's content by px
- `clip()` — clip the last element's children to its rect
- `at(x float, y float)` — take the last element out of the flow and pin it at (x, y) inside its parent's content box (overlays, carets, badges)

### style

- `bg(rgba int)` — background color, 0xRRGGBBAA
- `fg(rgba int)` — text color (inherited by children)
- `font(px float)` — font size (inherited)
- `bold()` — bold face (inherited)
- `radius(px float)` — corner radius (SDF, crisp at any scale)
- `border(px float, rgba int)` — inside border
- `shadow(blur float, rgba int)` — soft drop shadow

### state (survives hot reload)

- `state_int(key string, default int) -> int` — read a host-owned int (default on first read)
- `set_int(key string, v int)` — write it
- `state_f(key string, default float) -> float` — float variant
- `set_f(key string, v float)` — write it
- `state_str(key string, default string) -> string` — string variant
- `set_str(key string, v string)` — write it

### input & time

- `hovered(i int) -> bool` — pointer is over element i (last frame's layout)
- `pressed(i int) -> bool` — button held after a press that started on i
- `clicked(i int) -> bool` — released this frame on i after pressing on i
- `frame_no() -> int` — frames drawn since start
- `animate()` — ask for another frame right away (otherwise the app sleeps until input)

### keyboard & focus

- `key(scancode int) -> bool` — the key went down this frame (repeats included): K_RETURN, K_ESCAPE, K_BACKSPACE, K_TAB, K_DELETE, K_HOME, K_END, K_LEFT, K_RIGHT, K_UP, K_DOWN, K_PAGEUP, K_PAGEDOWN, K_A, K_C, K_N, K_S, K_V
- `ctrl() -> bool` — Ctrl (or Cmd) is held
- `shift() -> bool` — Shift is held
- `focused(key string) -> bool` — the field with this key has keyboard focus
- `focus(key string)` — give a field keyboard focus (e.g. after creating a note)
- `blur()` — clear focus (Esc and clicks outside any field do this too)

### window

- `window_title(s string)` — set the window title (no-op when unchanged)
- `cursor(CURSOR_DEFAULT|CURSOR_TEXT|CURSOR_POINTER)` — pointer shape for this frame (buttons and fields set it on hover)

### format

- `fmt2(v float) -> string` — two decimals, as Go's %.2f

## Colors

Ints 0xRRGGBBAA. Theme: C_BG, C_SURFACE, C_TEXT, C_MUTED, C_ACCENT (C_ACCENT_HI, C_ACCENT_LO), C_BORDER.

## Gotchas

- machin typechecks reachably: an error in a function view() never calls does not fail the build (and draws no overlay).
- MFL loops are `while cond { }`; there is no C-style for. Floats need a dot (16.0); int->float is float(i).
- Struct types are `type T struct { ... }` with one field per line.
- Colors are ints 0xRRGGBBAA; the alpha byte matters (0x...00 is invisible).
- Modifiers apply to the last element: call them right after the element (or right after end() for a container).
- To verify without a human: ./mdk shot <app> out.ppm --click X Y, then convert out.ppm out.png and look at it.
- State strings are per-frame copies: v := state_str(k, "") then set_str(k, v) is safe; keep long-lived text in the store, not in MFL globals.
- Text editing has no selection yet (ctrl+a moves the caret to the end; ctrl+Backspace deletes a word). text_area does not soft-wrap.
- Coordinates for --click are window pixels at scale 1: if you read a downscaled screenshot, scale back up before clicking.
- grow(f) children split the free space with a zero basis (CSS flex: 1); fixed siblings keep their size.
